DELETE PP
FROM [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaimsDetail_Response] PP
INNER JOIN [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog] RL
ON RL.RunLogID = PP.RunLogID
AND ProcessDate < CAST( DATEADD(MONTH, -3, GETDATE()) AS DATE )

Declare @Filename varchar(1000) = @0

INSERT INTO [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog]  (ProcessName, FileName, ProcessDate)
Values ('StateResponseImport',@Filename, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

select @@Identity RunLogID

Declare @RunLogID INT = @RunLogID_StateResponse

Update [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog] set [Status] = 'Completed' where RunLogID = @RunLogID

Declare @Filename varchar(1000) = @0
	,@FacetsFileName varchar(1000) = @1
	,@VendorFileName_EyeMed varchar(1000) = @2
	,@VendorFileName_LibertyDen varchar(1000) = @3
	,@VendorFileName_DentQ varchar(1000) = @4
	,@CurrentFileName varchar(1000)



IF @Filename = 'FACETS'
BEGIN
	SET @CurrentFileName = @FacetsFileName 
	INSERT INTO [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog]  (ProcessName, FileName, ProcessDate)
	Values ('CreateVendorRespone',@FacetsFileName, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

	select @@Identity RunLogID, @CurrentFileName CurrentFileName

END 

IF @Filename = 'EyeMed' 
BEGIN
	SET @CurrentFileName = @VendorFileName_EyeMed 
	INSERT INTO [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog]  (ProcessName, FileName, ProcessDate)
	Values ('CreateVendorRespone',@VendorFileName_EyeMed, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

	select @@Identity RunLogID, @CurrentFileName CurrentFileName

END 

IF @Filename = 'LibertyDental'
BEGIN
	SET @CurrentFileName = @VendorFileName_LibertyDen 
	INSERT INTO [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog]  (ProcessName, FileName, ProcessDate)
	Values ('CreateVendorRespone',@VendorFileName_LibertyDen, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

	select @@Identity RunLogID, @CurrentFileName CurrentFileName

END 

IF @Filename = 'DentaQuest'
BEGIN
	SET @CurrentFileName = @VendorFileName_DentQ 
	INSERT INTO [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog]  (ProcessName, FileName, ProcessDate)
	Values ('CreateVendorRespone',@VendorFileName_DentQ, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

	select @@Identity RunLogID, @CurrentFileName CurrentFileName

END

DECLARE @RunLogID_StateResponse INT = @RunLogID_StateResponse
	, @Source Varchar(100) = @VendFilesList_ForEach

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #CreateResponseFile
CREATE TABLE #CreateResponseFile (
	[TRACKING_ID] varchar(30),[MCE_CLAIM_ID] varchar(30),[FORM_TYPE] varchar(4),[BILL_TYPE] varchar(4),[CLAIM_STATUS] varchar(2),[CLAIM_REASON] varchar(30),[CLAIM_PROV_ID] varchar(15),[CLAIM_MEM_ID] varchar(25),[PAT_CTRL_NUM] varchar(30),[HEADER_BILLED_AMT] decimal(13,2),[STATUS_DETAIL_LINE] varchar(2),[REASON_DETAIL_LINE] varchar(30),[CLAIM_START_DT] varchar(10),[CLAIM_END_DT] varchar(10),[CLAIM_PAID_AMT] decimal(13,2),[CLAIM_LINE_NUM] int,[CLAIM_SERV_CODE] varchar(5),[MOD_CODE1] varchar(2),[MOD_CODE2] varchar(2),[REV_CODE] varchar(4),[SERV_UNITS] int,[CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT] decimal(13,2),[CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT] decimal(13,2),[REASON_FOR_REJECTION] varchar(60)
) 

INSERT INTO #CreateResponseFile
SELECT 
A.TRACKING_ID,
A.MCE_CLAIM_ID,
A.FORM_TYPE,					
A.BILL_TYPE,
A.CLAIM_STATUS,					
A.CLAIM_REASON,					
A.CLAIM_PROV_ID,					
A.CLAIM_MEM_ID,					
A.PAT_CTRL_NUM,
A.HEADER_BILLED_AMT,					
A.STATUS_DETAIL_LINE,					
A.REASON_DETAIL_LINE,					
A.CLAIM_START_DT,					
A.CLAIM_END_DT,					
A.CLAIM_PAID_AMT,					
A.CLAIM_LINE_NUM,					
A.CLAIM_SERV_CODE,					
A.MOD_CODE1,					
A.MOD_CODE2,					
A.REV_CODE,					
A.SERV_UNITS,					
A.CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT,					
A.CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT,					
A.REASON_FOR_REJECTION		
FROM  [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaimsDetail_Response] A					
INNER JOIN (SELECT TRACKING_ID, MCE_CLAIM_ID, CLAIM_LINE_NUM, [DATA_SOURCE] FROM [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_State] GROUP BY TRACKING_ID, MCE_CLAIM_ID, CLAIM_LINE_NUM, [DATA_SOURCE]) B					
	ON B.TRACKING_ID = A.TRACKING_ID 				
	AND B.MCE_CLAIM_ID = A.MCE_CLAIM_ID		
	AND B.CLAIM_LINE_NUM = A.CLAIM_LINE_NUM		
where a.RunLogID = @RunLogID_StateResponse		
AND B.[DATA_SOURCE] = @Source




/* Outbound File Format */

DECLARE @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST VARCHAR(MAX), @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST_qry NVARCHAR(MAX),
		@V_DATA_FIELD_LIST VARCHAR(MAX), @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST_qry NVARCHAR(MAX),
		@SQL VARCHAR(MAX),
		@TableName VARCHAR(100) = '#CreateResponseFile', 
		@Delimiter VARCHAR(1) 

SELECT @Delimiter =  CASE WHEN @Source = 'FACETS' THEN ',' ELSE '|' END  


SET @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST_qry =
	N'SELECT @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST = STUFF(
			(  SELECT '''+@Delimiter+''' + C.name + '''' FROM TEMPDB.sys.columns C WHERE C.object_id = T.object_id ORDER BY C.column_id FOR XML PATH('''')
		), 1, 1, '''')
	FROM TEMPDB.sys.tables T
	WHERE T.OBJECT_ID = ( SELECT OBJECT_ID(''TEMPDB..'+@TableName+'''))'

EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST_qry , N'@V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT', @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST OUTPUT;



SET @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST_qry =
	N'SELECT @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST = STUFF(
			( SELECT '' + ''''@Delimiter'''' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),['' + C.name + '']),'''''''')'' FROM TEMPDB.sys.columns C
		WHERE C.object_id = T.object_id ORDER BY C.column_id FOR XML PATH('''')
		), 1, 18, '''')
	FROM TEMPDB.sys.tables T
	WHERE T.OBJECT_ID = ( SELECT OBJECT_ID(''TEMPDB..'+@TableName+'''))'

EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST_qry , N'@V_DATA_FIELD_LIST NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT', @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST OUTPUT;
SET @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST = REPLACE(@V_DATA_FIELD_LIST, '@Delimiter', @Delimiter)


IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##DX_OH_PandPVendResp_RESULTSET') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##DX_OH_PandPVendResp_RESULTSET
CREATE TABLE ##DX_OH_PandPVendResp_RESULTSET (RecordType INT, ResultSet VARCHAR(MAX))

SET @SQL = '
INSERT INTO ##DX_OH_PandPVendResp_RESULTSET
SELECT 1 RecordType, ''' + @V_HEADER_FIELD_LIST + ''' as resultset

INSERT INTO ##DX_OH_PandPVendResp_RESULTSET
SELECT 2 RecordType, ' + @V_DATA_FIELD_LIST + ' as resultset
FROM  #CreateResponseFile'

EXEC (@SQL)

INSERT INTO ##DX_OH_PandPVendResp_RESULTSET

SELECT 3 RecordType, MAX(StateResponse_Status) + @Delimiter + CAST( COUNT(1) AS VARCHAR(10)) as resultset
FROM  #CreateResponseFile
INNER JOIN [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaimsTrailer_Response] 
ON 1=1 AND RunLogID = @RunLogID_StateResponse

Declare @RunLogID INT = @RunLogID_VendorResponse

Update [EXTRACT].[OH_CH_PendedPaidClaims_RunLog] set [Status] = 'Completed' where RunLogID = @RunLogID

VendFileResultQry.defaultValue: 'SELECT cast( ResultSet as varchar(max)) ResultSet FROM ##DX_OH_PandPVendResp_RESULTSET ORDER BY RecordType'
